changelog.text: - Added fast mode on Vertex in the global, us and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it

changes.title: fastMode description changed (+132 −72 chars)
changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-When true, fast mode is enabled. When absent or false, fast mode is off.
+When true, fast mode is enabled. When absent or false, fast mode is off. On Vertex a saved value is ignored: use /fast each session.
